metadata.description: Portable identity, evidence, assertion, and temporal primitives

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the full raw source bytes. check-evidence validates the digest for supported local sources when supplied; structural validation only checks its string type.

version.description: Provider revision or version identifying the source, such as a commit SHA or ticket revision; structural validation only checks its string type.

retrievedAt.description: Source retrieval time, conventionally an ISO 8601 timestamp; structural validation only checks its string type and does not enforce a date format.

Evidence.description: An exact locator and excerpt pointing to a source

Claim.description: A claim, not automatically a fact

Event.description: A happening, optionally located in time

occurredAt.description: Recorded occurrence time, represented as a date or timestamp string; the current validator checks only the string type and does not enforce a date format.

supportedBy.description: Cites evidence offered in support of a claim; the citation does not independently confirm that the claim is true.

contradicts.description: Records an explicit incompatibility between two claims. Symmetry is declared, but no reciprocal edge or truth judgment is inferred.

supersedes.description: Identifies a claim that replaces the standing of the target claim in the recorded context; both claims and their evidence remain distinct.

documentedIn.description: Identifies a source that records or describes the subject entity; the link does not validate every statement in that source.

derivedFrom.description: Records a derivation from the target entity into the subject entity, preserving provenance without equating their identities or verifying the result.
